name: Marcello Malpighi
summary: Seventeenth-century Italian anatomist and physician known for microscopic investigations of organs and tissues.

summary: Italian physiologist and mathematician who served as Malpighi's philosophical mentor.

summary: Italian physician and colleague of Malpighi who opposed microscopic anatomical investigations.

summary: Italian anatomist who joined the controversy against Sbaraglia and established pathological anatomy.

name: Henry Oldenburg
summary: Secretary of the Royal Society who corresponded with Malpighi.

name: Richard Waller
summary: Secretary of the Royal Society who received letters from Malpighi.

name: Pope Innocent XII
summary: Pope who appointed Malpighi as his personal archiater.

name: Francesco Redi
summary: Italian physician and naturalist acquainted with Malpighi.

name: Galileo Galilei
summary: Italian astronomer and physicist whose works influenced Malpighi's style and philosophy.

name: Robert Hooke
summary: English natural philosopher known for Micrographia.

name: Bologna University
summary: Italian university where Malpighi and Sbaraglia were colleagues.

name: Pisa University
summary: Italian university where Malpighi and Borelli met as professors.

name: Royal Society
summary: English scientific society that published Malpighi's works.

name: Bologna College of Physicians
summary: Professional body that elected Malpighi as a member.

name: Rome
